issue_title: [Bug] TodoApp 缺少 rename 功能的 CLI 命令入口

implementation.approach: Add rename subcommand to CLI following existing patterns

changes.description: Added rename method to TodoApp class, added 'rename' subcommand to build_parser(), and added rename handling in run_command()
Added regression tests for CLI rename command covering success case, nonexistent ID error, and empty text error
